Details that matter.

What does the Home Plan include?

The proposed offer combines a rented headset with an annual training subscription for one named trainee. Accessories, caregiver access and support coverage require confirmation.

Does the home plan include clinical assessment?

Clinical assessment is not included in this proposed home offer. Clinic assessment and training configurations follow a separate quotation pathway.

How much is the first year?

The proposed US offer is $499 for initial equipment rental plus $1,999 for the annual subscription: $2,498 before applicable tax. These are demo prices, not a live offer.

Where can I have it delivered?

Ask about the US, Europe, Japan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, Middle East and Brazil. Product eligibility, delivery charges and language support are confirmed for your specific destination.

What happens when I cancel?

The proposed approach is to stop the next renewal and return the rented equipment at the end of the paid term. Notice periods, refund rules and return deadlines are not yet approved.

Is the tablet in the photo included?

Not confirmed. The original image illustrates a headset and reporting setup; it does not establish the shipping contents of this proposed offer.
